  Old Town La Verne Business Improvement District

minutes_text:
OLD TOWN LA VERNE BUSINESS IMPROVEMENT DISTIRICT
  2022 MINUTES OF THE A NNUAL MEETING
  Monday, May 2, 2022

1.  WELCOME AND CALL TO ORDER

  Chairman Craig Walters welcomed attendees. They following board members were
  present: Marianne Stark, Mathew Forgey, Zuhey Espinoza, and Craig Walters. Not
  Present: Micky Rehm.

2.  CALENDAR

  Wine Walk – Saturday, May 14, 2022

3.  PRESENTATIONS

  Old Town District Update

  Chairman Craig Walters presented an update of the outdoor dining and upcoming Wine
  Walk.

  Chairman Walters also announced the recent passing of long time business owner
  Phillipe Sigal of Sigal Diamonds & Jewelry.

  L (Gold Line) Update

  Lisa Levy Busch of the Gold Line Construction Authority presented a construction
  update.

  Old Town Budget/City Update

  Community Development Director Eric Scherer presented the Budget report. It was
  moved by Ms. Stark and seconded by Mr. Forgey to recommend approval of the 2022/23
  Budget. The motion carried by a 4-0 vote.

  Mr. Scherer also presented a development update.

  University of La Verne Update

  Zuhey Espinoza provided an update on University activites.

4.  MEET THE CANDIDATES

  Chairman Walters introduced the City Council Candidates and each was given five
  minutes to speak.
   District 1: Muir Davis and Steven Frank Johnson
  District 2: Meshal “Kash” Kashifalghita (M. Joseph Gabaldon was not present)
  District 3: Tim Hepburn, Rich Gil, and Estella V. Maldonado

5.  PUBLIC COMMENT (Any discussion or action on non-agendized items must be
  deferred to the following meeting, as required by California Brown Act Law)

  None

7.  ADJOURNMENT

  Meeting was adjourned at 9:54 a.m., the next regular meeting to be held on Monday, June
  6, 2022 at 8:30 a.m. at Chase’s Restaurant.

  Respectively submitted,

  _____________________
  Natalie M. Hiatt
